liam: Ran into a rough onboarding friction in the edge starter. Using NodeNext tsconfig and the SDK types blow up with an unknown vs string error from createClient overload.

liam: error: `TS2345: Argument of type 'unknown' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'` at createClient<T = any>(opts: CreateOptions<T>): Client

sara: this is the generic-overload + package entry resolution mismatch. NodeNext can resolve a different types file than bundler consumers, so inference picks the wrong overload.

ben: Repro quick: new repo, tsconfig { module: 'NodeNext', moduleResolution: 'NodeNext' }, install sdk, run `tsc --noEmit` -> fail. Change moduleResolution to 'bundler' or module to 'ES2022' and it passes.

liam: quick patch I pushed to the sample: set `skipLibCheck: true` and a README note about using bundler mode for edge devs. Unblock flow but not ideal.

sara: long-term proposals: 1) add an explicit edge-friendly `types` export in package.json that points to a flattened d.ts without overlapping overloads; 2) add a dedicated factory export `createClientEdge<T = unknown>(...)` to avoid inference ambiguity; 3) prefer `unknown` in public APIs and document the rationale.

ben: also noticed our ESM edge bundle tree-shakes the auth/retry side-effect import which causes token refresh 401s in the sample. CJS path keeps it. Workaround for sample: `import '@redwood/sdk/compat/retries';` in entry.

sara: action items: - add CI compile matrix: NodeNext + bundler + vite/esbuild edge pipeline - publish flattened types path and wire `exports.types` for edge - add non-overloaded factory export - add sample README note + tsconfig snippet

ci-bot: Created issue #1321 (sdk: edge types & parity) assigned to @sara, labels: sdk, types, edge, dx

liam: I'll open the sample PR for tsconfig/README now. I'll link the issue and include the explicit import workaround. Thanks! :rocket:
